name: Trust Chem Co., Ltd.
summary: Trust Chem Co., Ltd. specializes in the creation, manufacturing, and global distribution of organic pigments. The company's reach extends across numerous territories, including China, Europe, the United States, Australia, Turkey, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom. Their product portfolio encompasses organic pigments, utilized in applications such as inks, coatings, and plastics, as well as inorganic pigments, fluorescent pigments, and a range of dyes and chemical intermediates. Founded in 1996, this enterprise maintains its primary headquarters in Hangzhou, China.
